name: Herbal Remedies for Vitiligo

sections.introduction:
Vitiligo is a skin disorder that leads to loss of skin and hair color in patches and blotches. Loss of color extent and its rate is not predictable. It can affect any area or any part of the body including hair as well as inside of the mouth. 
 The skin, eye and hair color is determined by a pigment called melanin. Vitiligo happens when cells producing melanin may die or stop functioning. The disorder is not that life-threatening or contagious but makes a person feel stressful and leads to low self- esteem. 
 Treatment although may heal and restore the affected area but it really cannot prevent continued and slow loss of skin color and its recurrence.
sections.vitiligo_symptoms_include:
Loss of skin color in blotches and patches 
 Slow and sudden graying of hair on head, eyelashes, eyebrows and beard 
 Loss of color of tissues which are found lining the inside of mouth and the nose too 
 Loss and sudden or slow change in color of the inner layer of the retina 

 Vitiligo can start at any age and appear before 20. The patches may cover the body including:- 

 Many parts 
 Only one side 
 One or only a few areas
sections.causes_of_vitiligo:
Immune system gets affected and attacks and finally destroys the melanocytes in the skin. 
 Family history 
 Sunburn, stress and continuous exposure to toxic chemicals
sections.complications_of_vitiligo:
Social and psychological distress 
 Sunburn, and skin cancers 
 Eye problems 
 Hearing loss
sections.diagnosis_of_vitiligo:
Medical history and exam 
 In case if you feel you have vitiligo you should visit your doctor. In that case your doctor might advise you for medical history and examine you. He would try to diagnose other skin problems like dermatitis and skin disorders. Your doctor might use a lamp for ultra violet to shine on the affected skin to determine vitiligo. 
 Skin biopsy and blood draw 
 In addition to above the doctor might even gather your personal and family history for diagnosing your skin problem. 

 In this case a small sample (biopsy) of the affected skin area is taken for testing. 
 Lab tests including drawing of blood for diagnosing autoimmune conditions like anemia and diabetes
